claim_ceiling: A local correlation-peak Hessian approximation for displacement covariance and first-order metrology propagation. It is not raw-image correlation processing, empirically calibrated coverage, or physical EHD validation.

statistical_model.local_covariance: Local Laplace approximation from the inverse observed Hessian of the negative log likelihood at a unique fitted correlation peak.
statistical_model.calibration_status: Local curvature alone is not empirical calibration; a calibrated claim requires an external empirical interval-coverage receipt on independent acquisition clusters.
statistical_model.invalid_curvature: The observed Hessian must be symmetric positive definite; non-positive-definite curvature is rejected rather than regularized.

velocity_model.cross_component_covariance: Uncertainty in shared calibration/timing inputs can induce cross-component covariance even when the displacement covariance is diagonal.
velocity_model.assumptions: Local displacement components and the metres-per-pixel and pulse-separation inputs are mutually independent unless an explicitly evidenced joint covariance is supplied.

reference_implementation.role: local Hessian covariance and first-order displacement-to-velocity propagation
